Riji_Arali_(tantrarājanāma)
or Vajra Arali. Bud. tantra. pronounced by Rigi, a Yogeśvara a. the request of Arali, a. Mahāyogin. AMG. II. p. 296. AR. XX. p. 494 (Rigi Ārali).
--transl. in Tib. in Kanjour by Gayadhara an. a Tib. Scholar. AR XX. p. 494.
--transl. by Kāyasthāpagayadhara. Kanjur Kyoto 66. Sendai 427.
